name: Scroll
source: https://scroll.io (the inline mark-scroll SVG of the site header and footer; docs.scroll.io serves the same mark)
notes: Default: the current Scroll mark from scroll.io, its five paths unchanged, in the site's --ink colour #0A0A0A (the paths use currentColor and the header sets color:var(--ink)); it replaces the earlier beige tile with the coloured scroll, which scroll.io and docs.scroll.io no longer use (scroll.io/brand-kit returns 404)
Mono: the same five paths in currentColor
